description: Return a list of all searched equipment with details for a specified project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: filters[managed_equipment_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Managed Equipment ID.

parameters.name: filters[managed_equipment_category_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Managed Equipment Category ID.

parameters.name: filters[managed_equipment_type_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Managed Equipment Type ID.

parameters.name: filters[managed_equipment_make_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Managed Equipment Make ID.

parameters.name: filters[managed_equipment_model_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Managed Equipment Model ID.

parameters.name: filters[company_visible]
parameters.description: If true, return item(s) with 'company visible' status.

parameters.name: filters[current_project_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified current project ID.

parameters.name: filters[year]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified year.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) matching the specified status value.

parameters.name: filters[last_service_date]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with a last service date within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[next_service_date]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with a next service date within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: search_keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword to search Project Managed Equipment.

parameters.name: filters[onsite]
parameters.description: Onsite Dates. Returns item(s) with the specified range of onsite dates.

parameters.name: filters[offsite]
parameters.description: Offsite Dates. Returns item(s) with the specified range of offsite dates.

parameters.name: filters[ownership]
parameters.description: Returns only item(s) with the specified ownership value. Must be one of Owned, Rented, or Sub.

parameters.name: filters[vendor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Vendor ID.

parameters.name: filters[induction_status]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) with the specified inudction status.

id.description: Unique identifier of the managed equipment.

name.description: Display name of the managed equipment.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this managed equipment.

current_project_id.description: Identifier of the project this equipment is currently dispatched to. Null if not assigned.

company_visible.description: Whether this equipment is visible at the company level across all projects.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this managed equipment was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this managed equipment was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this managed equipment was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

managed_equipment_make_id.description: Identifier of the equipment make associated with this equipment.

managed_equipment_model_id.description: Identifier of the equipment model associated with this equipment.

managed_equipment_type_id.description: Identifier of the equipment type associated with this equipment.

managed_equipment_category_id.description: Identifier of the equipment category associated with this equipment.

year.description: Year the equipment was manufactured in.

status.description: Current operational status of the equipment.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this managed equipment.
